summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Vision

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Prompt-to-Prompt in the Vision area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Prompt-to-prompt image editing with cross attention control”. The page names Amir Hertz, Daniel Cohen-Or as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
